scenarios.prompt: Using the pinned pair `assets/blender/arrival-helicopter.blend` and `public/models/arrival-helicopter.glb`, define a source/interchange validation pass for scale, axes, pivots, attachments and collision without assuming the demo runtime is correct.

criteria.ownership: Owns source/interchange units, pivots, collision proxies, export and validation; adapters own one runtime conversion.
criteria.preservation: Optimization preserves skins, morphs, sockets, animation and collision alignment required by the project.
criteria.evidence: Import/reimport measurements demonstrate physical scale, contact plane, attachment and collision tolerances before claiming success.
